// @title Megalovania
// @by Toby Fox
// transcribed @by tzwaan

setCpm(120/4)


$: n("<-@4 0@20 1@16 2@16 3@16 -!6>".pickRestart([
"<0 -1 -1b[-2 -1 _]>",
"<-2 -1 0[0b 1b _]>",
"<-2 -1<-1b 0>!2>",
"<-2 -1<[0 0b _]0><[-1 -1b _]0>>"
])).scale("d2:minor").add(note("<0!8[0,12]!64 -!6>"))
.s("supersaw,<-!8 gm_distortion_guitar:4!64 -!6>,<-!56 gm_overdriven_guitar:1!16 -!6>")
.add.out(note("0*2@4 0 0*3@6 0!3<0!56 12!16 -!6>_"))
.diode("1:<.35!56 .3!16 -!6>")
.room(1)
.clip(.8).rel(.1)
.penv(-0.5)
.patt(.03)
.lpf(1700).lpq(6)

"<-2 -1 0 0>!2 -!14",
"-!2 7 - 4 - - 4b - 3 - 2 _ 0 2 3",
`<
[2:2:.1 _ 2[2!3 0]@8 0@5][2 _ 2 2 _[3 _ 3*2]@2 4b _ 3 2 0 2 3@3][2 _ 2[2 3 4b 4 6]@10 4@3][7*2@4 7 4 7 6@9]
[[2,4]:2:.1 _[2,4][2!3 0,4!3 3]@8[0,3]@5][[2,4]_[2,4][2 2 0 2 1,4 4 3 4 7]@10[0,4][-1,3]_][7 4 3 2 6 3 2 1][-2 _ -1 0 1 2 _ 6:1:.5@9]
>`,
`<
[-[2 0 2 3 4b 3 2 0]][[4b 3 0]_ 2 _ 3@9 4b _ 4][6 - 4 4b 3 2 0 1[2 3 4 6]@8][7b _ 4b _ 4b 3 2 3@9]
[[0 1][2 7]6 4,[2 3][4 9]8 7][3 4 6 3,8 9 10 8][[7,11][11 11b 10 10b 9 8 8b 7]][[4,7]:1.2:2.2 [5,8b]]
>`,
"- -[7,9]-[6,8]- -[4,6]-[6,8]-[4,7]-[2,4][4,6][4,7]",
]).as("n:penv:patt")
.scale("<d3!8[d3,d4]!8 d5!8[d5,d4]!16 d3!14[d3,d4]!2 d3!16 d3!6>:minor")
.set("<[saw,pulse]!8[saw,gm_orchestra_hit:2:.7]!8 pulse:0:1.2!8[pulse,gm_brass_section:[0,2]:.8]!16[saw,pulse]:0:1.1!14[saw,gm_orchestra_hit:2:.7]!2[saw,pulse]:0:1.3!16[saw,pulse]!6>".as("s:n:gain"))
.rel("<0!8 .3!8 .1!8 .3!16 0!14 .3!2 0!16 0!6>")
.room("<0@8 1@32 1@14 1!2 0!16 0!6>").roomsize(2)
.vib("<0!8 8:.13!32 0!14 8:.1!2 0!16 0!6>")
.clip(.95)


$: "<-@16 -@4 0@4 -@16 1@14 -@24>".pickRestart([

]).as("n:penv:patt").scale("d4:minor")
